query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, me brave crew! The sea be wide, the map be true, and somewhere beyond that blood-red horizon lies a treasure fit for legends!

Hoist the sails, sharpen yer wits, and let no storm, reef, nor rival scoundrel turn us aside. Every shovel of sand, every step through jungle, every creak of the deck brings us closer to gold enough to make kings bow and taverns sing our names!

So grip the ropes, steady yer hearts, and follow me! For tonight we chase not just treasure—but glory, freedom, and a tale that’ll outlive us all!

**Now onward, ye sea dogs—fortune favors the bold!**
